sections.voiceover: Only 35% of working Americans have an emergency fund, a shocking drop from previous years.
Pew Research Center found that more than half of Americans do not have rainy day funds.
But it's not just about having an emergency fund. The survey also found that 44% of Americans do not have $1,000 in emergency savings.
That's a big drop from previous years. That's shockingly low, but you can prepare for it.
Start saving today and build your emergency fund.
